rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the animal.

example.english: I saw an elephant at the zoo.
example.traditional: 我喺動物園見到一隻大象。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 dung6 mat6 jyun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 daai6 zoeng6

rows.note: Use this colloquial term when speaking informally about an elephant, often with a playful emphasis on its size.

example.jyutping: go2 zek3 daai6 ban6 zoeng6 haang4 dak1 hou2 maan6

rows.note: Use this shorter form mainly in written or compact contexts rather than as the everyday spoken default.

example.english: The elephant is one of the largest animals on land.
example.traditional: 象為陸地上最大的動物之一。
example.jyutping: zoeng6 wai4 luk6 dei6 soeng6 zeoi3 daai6 dik1 dung6 mat6 zi1 jat1
